theorems.name: Submission.br_cube_integral_fderiv_eq_faces
theorems.statement: ∀ (n : ℕ) (ρ : ℝ), 0 ≤ ρ → ∀ (φ : (Fin (n + 1) → ℝ) → ℝ), ContDiff ℝ 1 φ → ∀ (i : Fin (n + 1)), ∫ s in Set.Icc (0 : Fin (n + 1) → ℝ) (fun _ => ρ), fderiv ℝ φ s (Pi.single i 1) = ∫ s in Set.Icc (0 : Fin n → ℝ) (fun _ => ρ), (φ (Fin.insertNth i ρ s) - φ (Fin.insertNth i 0 s))
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
